title_en: Babies Have Almost 100 More Bones Than Adults #Shorts
desc_en:
A newborn has about 275 to 300 bones. As we grow, small bones fuse together, and most adults end up with 206. Bones make up about 15% of body weight and store about 99% of the body's calcium.

Sources: Cleveland Clinic; Britannica; Healthline.
Directed by L.S.M · Dreamloom Studio (Heosang Gongbang)

#shorts #science
